team_page.title: Our Team
team_page.subtitle: Experts dedicated to your success
team_page.jean_bio_1: Jean Laporte founded Groupe Laporte in 2011. Founder and President of the firm, he holds the designation of Master Corporate Executive Coach (ACEC). Trained at Harvard University and Columbia University, he brings a unique perspective combining academic rigor with exceptional field experience.
team_page.jean_bio_2: His business career is remarkable: Vice-President at Apple Canada, National Vice-President of Sales at Fido, and President of Eastern Canada at Rogers with over 4,000 employees under his leadership. This top-level executive experience gives him unmatched credibility with his clients.
team_page.jean_bio_3: He is also the author of «Laporte de la réussite», a reference work for Quebec's business leaders. His mission: to improve the business world, one leader at a time.
team_page.jf_bio: Jean-François Brault brings his expertise in financial analysis to serve Quebec SMEs. He collaborates with Groupe Laporte to help executives make strategic decisions based on solid financial data and relevant performance indicators.
team_page.kathryn_bio: Kathryn Peterson specializes in human relations and interpersonal skills development. She supports Groupe Laporte's leaders in managing high-performing teams, conflict resolution, and developing a healthy organizational culture.
team_page.collaborate_desc: Are you an expert in coaching or organizational development? We are always looking for passionate collaborators.

services_page.title: Our Services
services_page.subtitle: Executive coaching solutions tailored to each leader
services_page.intro: At Groupe Laporte, we offer personalized support based on decades of experience at the highest levels of corporate leadership. Each service is designed to generate measurable and lasting results.

cape_page.title: CAPE Forum
cape_page.subtitle: The exclusive development environment for senior executives
cape_page.intro: The CAPE Forum is an intensive development program designed specifically for senior executives who want to accelerate their professional growth in an environment of total trust and absolute confidentiality.
cape_page.structure_1_desc: Monthly half-day sessions, structured around strategic themes relevant to the current challenges of senior executives.
cape_page.structure_2_desc: An intensive one-day retreat that fosters deep learning and lasting connections among members.
cape_page.structure_3_desc: A significant annual investment in your professional development, structured to maximize impact on your performance.
cape_page.roi_note: The average ROI for our members is 50% on their annual investment.
cape_page.confidentiality_text: All CAPE Forum members commit to a strict confidentiality charter. What you share in the forum stays in the forum.
cape_page.cta_desc: Spots are limited to ensure quality and confidentiality. Contact us to check availability.

consultation_page.title: Consultation & Coaching
consultation_page.subtitle: Personalized support to maximize your impact
consultation_page.intro: Our individual consultation and coaching service is designed for leaders who want to reach a new level of performance. Through a rigorous and personalized approach, we help you identify your growth levers and activate them.
consultation_page.coaching_desc: One-on-one support with Jean Laporte, ACEC, to explore your leadership challenges, clarify your vision and develop your full management potential.
consultation_page.consultation_desc: An in-depth analysis of your organizational context with concrete and actionable recommendations to improve the performance of your team and organization.
consultation_page.conferences_desc: Dynamic and engaging presentations on key topics for your leadership teams:
consultation_page.conference_4: My Life My Way© — public program
consultation_page.process_1_desc: In-depth assessment of your situation, objectives and current challenges.
consultation_page.process_2_desc: Development of a customized action plan with clear and measurable objectives.
consultation_page.process_3_desc: Regular follow-up sessions to ensure progress and adjust the plan as needed.
consultation_page.process_4_desc: Results assessment and consolidation of learnings for lasting transformation.
consultation_page.final_cta_title: Ready to Reach the Next Level?
consultation_page.final_cta_desc: Schedule a complimentary initial consultation with Jean Laporte.

gestion_page.title: My Life My Way©
gestion_page.subtitle: Regain control of your priorities
gestion_page.intro: My Life My Way© is a unique priority management program that helps executives and leaders create an intentional balance between their professional, family and personal responsibilities.
gestion_page.pillar_1_desc: Define your professional ambitions, strategic priorities and leadership vision for the short and long term.
gestion_page.pillar_2_desc: Clarify your role in your family, define your family values and create habits that nurture your important relationships.
gestion_page.pillar_3_desc: Identify your passions, health, personal development and create space for what fulfills you.
gestion_page.format_heading: A structured program for an intentional life
gestion_page.format_1_desc: An intensive session to discover the method and start building your life plan.
gestion_page.format_2_desc: A detailed plan with concrete objectives for each of the three spheres over the next 12 months.
gestion_page.format_3_desc: A strategic projection of your ideal life in 5 years, across all three spheres.
gestion_page.impact_desc: executives across North America have transformed their lives through this program.
gestion_page.cta_desc: Discover how My Life My Way© can help you live more intentionally and fulfillingly.

privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.subtitle: How we handle your personal information
privacy_page.intro: Groupe Laporte ("we") is committed to protecting the personal information of this site's visitors, in accordance with Quebec's Act Respecting the Protection of Personal Information in the Private Sector (Law 25).
privacy_page.collecte_text: We only collect the information you voluntarily provide through our contact form: name, email address, phone number, company name, service of interest, and message. This site does not use tracking cookies or third-party analytics tools.
privacy_page.utilisation_text: The information collected is used solely to respond to your request and follow up on your file. We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy_page.conservation_text: Your information is kept only as long as necessary to respond to your request, then securely destroyed or anonymized.
privacy_page.droits_text: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting us at the address below.
privacy_page.contact_text: For any question about this policy or your personal information, contact us at info@groupelaporte.ca or 1 514 400-0671.
